claim: D8-09 (interactions between fields belong to no one): Conway's law (Conway 1968), since level-1 sessions cannot talk, so the synthesis has boxes and no edges; give the interfaces an owner (cross-field question ids, each assigned to one field).

D8-10 (recall when the relevant set is unknown): pooling for test collections (Spaerck Jones and van Rijsbergen 1975), pool bias measured (Zobel 1998) and snowballing (Wohlin 2014), where all readers share one tool and model so the pool is not diverse; seeds in the brief cannot measure coverage.

D8-11 (faults not yet found by overlapping inspections): capture-recapture for inspections (Eick et al. 1992) and the estimator for unequal catchability (Chao 1987), where same-model lenses are correlated and bias low; lenses from different fields are heterogeneous, which Chao tolerates; read as a lower bound.
